counting_policy: A distinct external scientific or collaboration service counts once only after its live API or page was actually consulted for this study. Multiple URLs, entries or repeated calls to one service do not multiply the count. Local libraries, model components and named but unused tools do not count.

caveat: Strict ledger counts 40 distinct actually queried scientific data/literature services, excluding GitHub and Drive and collapsing Ensembl gene and VEP endpoints. Crossref, OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar independently verified the same DOI/PMID and count as three literature-index services, NOT as three independent studies or assays. More services do not strengthen the biological result; no functional rescue claim follows from service count.
